target_statement: At one bounded actual-prime scale, test whether retained-hat top-band fourth-moment energy or sampled negative peaks are enriched on centers phase-aligned with one common prime-interval sum, including an adversarial scan over common ordinates.
mask_or_node_class: All ordinary primes in each logarithmic shell; exact physical adjacent-gap retention rule g <= Y^(161/1000); floating quadrature for the retained nodal weights.
source_data_retained: One fixed contiguous actual-prime interval I and one common ordinate tau; center phase alignment is evaluated exactly from Re(Y^(i tau) S_I(tau)).
coefficient_cone_and_sign: Nonnegative retained-hat probability coefficients for the upper antenna; no LTRAD optimizer is approximated.
normalization: Retained coefficients sum to one; source coherence is recorded both as |S_I|/#I and mass-normalized depth |S_I|/N.
height_window_and_one_sided_floor: Only randomized top-band samples t in [Y^(50/33),2Y^(50/33)] are used; this is an L4 and negative-peak proxy, not a full-band floor certificate.
quantifier_order: Fix actual-prime interval I; compute center energy; scan common tau in [N^(1/2),N], including a preregistered source-coherence choice and a hostile energy-enrichment choice; compare aligned and unaligned centers.
resolution_required: Top-band phases are sampled directly at Y^(50/33); no interpolation from source height is asserted.

rate_and_exponent_ledger.legal_depth_target: N^(-1/1000), known to be impossible at this finite scale by the prime-count ceiling

feasibility_or_nonvacuity_witness: The fixed source interval is contained in every sampled shell, and every common tau defines a nonempty positive-density phase arc unless S_I(tau)=0.
downstream_socket: A stable actual-prime enrichment would warn that source alignment and upper exceptional centers cannot be treated as independent. Absence of enrichment only removes that finite warning and proves no density theorem.
why_not_target_renamed: The probe computes neither an asymptotic center average nor any source-conditioned radial radius; it asks only a finite morphology/correlation question.

fast_falsifiers.abstract_convex: Not licensed: the center-density intersection lemma is deterministic and cannot be refuted by arbitrary convex data.
fast_falsifiers.fejer_half_grid: Already shows that center averaging alone does not imply conductor gain; the present probe looks only for an additional actual-prime co-resonance.
fast_falsifiers.prime_density_pseudonode: Not rerun: a phase-aligned smooth control can mimic density but not the exact moving adjacent-prime mask.
fast_falsifiers.finite_actual_prime: Primary test: aligned/un-aligned energy ratios, rank correlations, top-tail overlap, replicate Monte Carlo error, circular-shift controls, and a hostile tau scan.

actual_prime_arithmetic_line: The moving retained edge mask and nodal weights use actual consecutive prime gaps; source phases use the same actual primes.
decision_tree_change_if_signal_found: Do not assume generic phase equidistribution makes the lower witness set independent of upper failures; any future coupled theorem must defeat the measured co-resonance mechanism.
decision_tree_change_if_no_signal: The simplest finite co-resonance falsifier fails, but both asymptotic inputs remain open and unchanged.
stop_rule: No asymptotic exponent, GCG4, LTRAD, strip, or RH claim; stop after one center block, one fixed source interval, two independent top-band sampling replicates, and a bounded tau scan.
